definitions.explanation: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another; feeling connected to others' emotions or views.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{意見|いけん}に{共感|きょうかん}する。
この{映画|えいが}は{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}の{共感|きょうかん}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: This movie resonated with many people.

examples.japanese: {共感|きょうかん}{能力|のうりょく}が{高|たか}い{人|ひと}は{相手|あいて}の{気持|きも}ちがわかる。
examples.english: People with high empathy can understand others' feelings.

notes:
{共感|きょうかん} refers to sharing feelings with others.

WORD FORMATION:
- {共|きょう} (together) + {感|かん} (feeling) = feeling together

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共感|きょうかん}する: to empathize, to sympathize
- {共感|きょうかん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to evoke sympathy/resonance
- {共感|きょうかん}を{得|え}る: to gain sympathy
- {共感|きょうかん}{能力|のうりょく}: empathy, ability to empathize
- {共感|きょうかん}{性|せい}: empathetic quality

CONTRAST:
- {共感|きょうかん}: sharing feelings, understanding emotionally
- {同情|どうじょう}: sympathy, pity (can be one-way)
- {思|おも}いやり}: consideration, thoughtfulness
